flags.why: “Sở dĩ” introduces the outcome whose reason will be explained, whereas “that is why” introduces a consequence.
flags.fix: the reason why ... (usually in the construction sở dĩ ... là vì/nhờ ...)

flags.why: Learners commonly encounter “lành tính” describing a gentle temperament or products that are mild and unlikely to cause irritation.
flags.fix: Add meanings: gentle; good-natured (of a person or animal); mild; non-irritating (of a product or substance).

flags.why: Calling someone “bụi đời” can disparage them as a vagabond or disreputable street person.
